description: This file defines a template class 'LockableContainerType' that extends a container with thread-safe read/write locking capabilities using a ReadWriteLock. It provides methods for acquiring and releasing read and write locks, and manages lock state internally.

classes.name: LockableContainerType
classes.description: A thread-safe container wrapper that adds read/write locking capabilities to an existing container type.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator that copies the contents from another LockableContainerType instance while managing lock acquisition and release.

methods.name: ReadLock
methods.description: Acquires a read lock on the container, waiting up to the specified time.

methods.name: ReadUnlock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired read lock.

methods.name: WriteLock
methods.description: Acquires a write lock on the container, waiting up to the specified time.

methods.name: WriteUnlock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired write lock.
